title: Men's Fishing – You Catching 'Em? No. Keep Walking. Embroidered Zip Hoodie

seo.title: Fisherman Zip Up Hoodie – You Catching 'Em? No. Keep Walking
seo.description: A fisherman zip up hoodie: YOU CATCHING 'EM? NO. KEEP WALKING. on the back over a grumpy angler in a lawn chair, plus an embroidered fish on the chest.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This fisherman zip up hoodie is for the fisherman who answers every "you catching 'em?" from the trail with a flat stare, zipped on for the dawn bank and the cold lawn chair.

A grumpy old man in a bucket hat and plaid shirt sits in a folding lawn chair beside a fishing rod and a bucket while a jogger runs past behind him, in sage, rust, cream and charcoal with a worn print texture. YOU CATCHING 'EM? runs above it and NO. KEEP WALKING. below in tall condensed capitals, the last line wider than the first: sage green and rust on Black and Navy, forest green and brick red on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small fish in side view with its tail, fins and eye is embroidered on the left chest, and the word NO. is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest fish and left-cuff NO., printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the You Catching 'Em? No. Keep Walking. zip hoodie fit?
The You Catching 'Em? No. Keep Walking. fisherman zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this fisherman hoodie warm enough for cold lake banks?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cold lake banks, dawn boat ramps and the long drive home well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, YOU CATCHING 'EM? above the scene and NO. KEEP WALKING. below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small fish in side view with its tail, fins and eye sits on the left chest with no words, and NO. is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The fish on the chest and the NO. cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a fisherman, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the angler who has no interest in small talk on the bank. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
